title: Neo4j schema indexes: existence, shape, state, use by the product's queries, resilience, scoping

cases.title: the six cbm_* range indexes exist on :CbmNode and are ONLINE
cases.cypher: SHOW INDEXES YIELD name, state, type, labelsOrTypes, properties, populationPercent WHERE name STARTS WITH 'cbm_node_' RETURN name, state, type, labelsOrTypes, properties, populationPercent ORDER BY name

cases.title: each index covers exactly the documented property list
cases.cypher: SHOW INDEXES YIELD name, properties WHERE name STARTS WITH 'cbm_node_' RETURN name, properties ORDER BY name

cases.title: every cbm_* index is fully populated
cases.cypher: SHOW INDEXES YIELD name, populationPercent WHERE name STARTS WITH 'cbm_node_' AND populationPercent < 100 RETURN name

cases.title: uniqueness constraint cbm_project_name on CbmProject(name)
cases.cypher: SHOW CONSTRAINTS YIELD name, type, labelsOrTypes, properties WHERE name = 'cbm_project_name' RETURN name, type, labelsOrTypes, properties

cases.title: the constraint is enforced (a duplicate CbmProject is refused; nothing is written)
cases.cypher: CREATE (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) RETURN p.name

cases.title: read the project's current generation for the plan checks
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) RETURN p.gen

cases.title: PLAN: label lookup seeks cbm_node_label (db, gen, label) [tier 2: on a 137-node graph the cost planner may prefer an index scan; the authoritative check is the PROFILE ceiling in N09-30..36]
cases.cypher: EXPLAIN MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $db, gen: $gen, label: 'File'}) WHERE n.project = $project RETURN count(n)

cases.title: PLAN: qualified-name lookup seeks cbm_node_qn [tier 2: on a 137-node graph the cost planner may prefer an index scan; the authoritative check is the PROFILE ceiling in N09-30..36]
cases.cypher: EXPLAIN MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $db, gen: $gen, qualified_name: $qn}) RETURN n.id

cases.title: PLAN: id lookup (batched node reads) seeks cbm_node_id [tier 2: on a 137-node graph the cost planner may prefer an index scan; the authoritative check is the PROFILE ceiling in N09-30..36]
cases.cypher: EXPLAIN UNWIND $ids AS i MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $db, gen: $gen, id: i}) RETURN n.id, n.name

cases.title: PLAN: name lookup seeks cbm_node_name [tier 2: on a 137-node graph the cost planner may prefer an index scan; the authoritative check is the PROFILE ceiling in N09-30..36]
cases.cypher: EXPLAIN MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $db, gen: $gen, name: 'hub'}) RETURN n.id

cases.title: PLAN: the product's hinted full-scan page seeks cbm_node_file by range and never label-scans [tier 2: on a 137-node graph the cost planner may prefer an index scan; the authoritative check is the PROFILE ceiling in N09-30..36]
cases.cypher: EXPLAIN MATCH (n:CbmNode) USING INDEX n:CbmNode(db, gen, file_path) WHERE n.db = $db AND n.gen = $gen AND n.file_path >= $after_file AND ($keyed = false OR n.file_path > $after_file OR n.id > $after_id) AND ($project IS NULL OR n.project = $project) RETURN n.id, n.file_path ORDER BY n.db, n.gen, n.file_path, n.id LIMIT $max

cases.title: PLAN: the hinted full-scan page does not sort the whole remainder (PartialTop/PartialSort, no plain Sort)
cases.cypher: EXPLAIN MATCH (n:CbmNode) USING INDEX n:CbmNode(db, gen, file_path) WHERE n.db = $db AND n.gen = $gen AND n.file_path >= $after_file AND ($keyed = false OR n.file_path > $after_file OR n.id > $after_id) AND ($project IS NULL OR n.project = $project) RETURN n.id, n.file_path ORDER BY n.db, n.gen, n.file_path, n.id LIMIT $max

cases.title: PLAN: the product's hinted label page seeks cbm_node_label [tier 2: on a 137-node graph the cost planner may prefer an index scan; the authoritative check is the PROFILE ceiling in N09-30..36]
cases.cypher: EXPLAIN MATCH (n:CbmNode) USING INDEX n:CbmNode(db, gen, label) WHERE n.db = $db AND n.gen = $gen AND n.id > $after_id AND n.label = $label AND ($project IS NULL OR n.project = $project) RETURN n.id ORDER BY n.id LIMIT $max

cases.title: PLAN: db-only lookup (old-generation delete shape) seeks cbm_node_db [tier 2: on a 137-node graph the cost planner may prefer an index scan; the authoritative check is the PROFILE ceiling in N09-30..36]
cases.cypher: EXPLAIN MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $db}) WHERE n.gen <> $gen RETURN count(n)

cases.title: PLAN: the File-list query (list_files) seeks the label index [tier 2: on a 137-node graph the cost planner may prefer an index scan; the authoritative check is the PROFILE ceiling in N09-30..36]
cases.cypher: EXPLAIN MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $db, gen: $gen, label: 'File'}) WHERE n.project = $project WITH n.file_path AS path WHERE path <> '' RETURN DISTINCT path ORDER BY path

cases.title: PROFILE: label count really runs through the index (records db hits for the scorecard)
cases.cypher: PROFILE MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $db, gen: $gen, label: 'File'}) WHERE n.project = $project RETURN count(n)

cases.title: only one generation of the project exists in Neo4j
cases.cypher: MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $db}) WHERE n.gen <> $gen RETURN count(n)

cases.title: label is stored both as a property and as a Neo4j label (same count)
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (n:CbmNode:Function {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project}) WITH count(n) AS by_label MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (m:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project, label: 'Function'}) RETURN by_label, count(m), by_label = count(m)

cases.title: sync_format 2: every node carries prop_keys
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen}) WHERE n.prop_keys IS NULL RETURN count(n)

cases.title: scalar properties are flattened: a Function row has file_path, start_line, label
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project, name: 'hub', label: 'Function'}) RETURN n.file_path, n.start_line, n.qualified_name, n.properties_json

cases.title: every CALLS relationship keeps type='CALLS' and an id
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen})-[r:CALLS]->() WHERE r.type <> 'CALLS' OR r.id IS NULL RETURN count(r)

cases.title: non-identifier edge types land on CBM_EDGE with the real type kept (record the count)
cases.cypher: MATCH (:CbmNode {db: $project})-[r:CBM_EDGE]->() RETURN count(r), collect(DISTINCT r.type)[..5]

cases.title: hub has exactly 12 inbound CALLS in Neo4j
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (c:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project})-[:CALLS]->(h:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project, name: 'hub'}) RETURN count(c)

cases.title: no cross-project edges: every relationship joins nodes of the same db and gen
cases.cypher: MATCH (a:CbmNode {db: $project})-[r]->(b:CbmNode) WHERE b.db <> a.db OR b.gen <> a.gen RETURN count(r)

cases.title: the ::missed coverage graph, if any, is under the same db but its own project key
cases.cypher: MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $project}) WHERE n.project <> $project AND NOT n.project ENDS WITH '::missed' RETURN count(n)

cases.title: RESILIENCE: drop cbm_node_file by hand (test instance only)
cases.cypher: DROP INDEX cbm_node_file IF EXISTS
